contests.title: Goodlettsville — Sales and Use Tax Referendum

provenance.quote:
City of Goodlettsville
      Sales and Use Tax Referendum
           Vote for One (1)

Shall the Goodlettsville Investment Act
(Ordinance No. 26-1146) for the purpose
of investing in vital City services such as
parks, roads, and public safety, by
increasing the City’s sales tax by a half-
penny per dollar, be approved?

   ◼ For

   ◼ Against

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Approves the Goodlettsville Investment Act, Ordinance 26-1146, raising the city’s sales tax by half a penny per dollar to fund city services such as parks, roads and public safety.
measureRecords.yesMeans: A FOR vote approves the ordinance and half-penny-per-dollar city sales-tax increase.
measureRecords.noMeans: An AGAINST vote rejects the proposed ordinance and tax increase.
